description: Crisis Control Ministry provides short-term help during a financial crisis in Forsyth and Stokes counties. Assistance starts with an interview.
introduction: Crisis Control Ministry provides short-term help during a financial crisis in Forsyth and Stokes counties. Assistance starts with an interview.

sections.who: The ministry verifies the cause of the crisis and considers whether household finances can recover. A crisis is an unusual event outside your control. Residents of ZIP codes 27107 and 27127 are directed to Sunnyside Ministries first for financial assistance.
sections.get: Financial help can address rent or mortgage costs, utilities, heating fuel and certain housing or utility deposits. Staff assess the need, other available resources and a workable recovery plan.
sections.docs: Prepare household income and major expenses before the interview. Have the relevant bill, notice and evidence explaining the crisis ready. Staff tell you if further records are needed.
sections.apply:
1. Call Winston-Salem client services at 336-724-7453 to ask about assistance. Phone and in-person interviews are available.

  2. Explain the event that caused the shortfall, the amount due and any shutoff or housing deadline. Ask which office and interview route to use.

  3. Provide requested records and ask about the decision, payment timing and any remaining balance.
sections.after: Keep a record of the outcome. Confirm any payment or postponement with the landlord or utility; requesting help alone does not suspend a deadline.

faqs: The ministry offers telephone as well as in-person interviews. Call to arrange the appropriate route.
What financial problems can it help with?
Its financial-assistance page lists rent or mortgage, utilities, heating fuel and some deposit assistance. Staff assess each request.
What should I prepare before calling?
Household income and major expenses, plus records of the bill and crisis.
Does it cover everyone in every ZIP code?
Its service area is Forsyth and Stokes counties, but it directs residents of 27107 and 27127 to Sunnyside Ministries first for financial help.
